issues.claim: EAB Insurance Group, 929 Washington Ave, listed under town 'Dunellen (borough edge; confirm)'
issues.problem: Wrong town. The agency's own website describes it as 'headquartered in Green Brook, NJ'; Green Brook directory and map listings place 929 Washington Ave in Green Brook Township, not the Borough of Dunellen. The mapper flagged the doubt in notes but still listed it, which breaks the zone rule that entries must be physically in the borough.
issues.fix: Remove from the Dunellen zone list (or move to the Green Brook zone). Do not include in Dunellen outreach.

issues.claim: Williamson Realty Inc, 319 US Highway 22, listed under town 'Dunellen (US-22 corridor; likely outside borough)'
issues.problem: Wrong town. Realtor.com lists Williamson Realty, Inc. at 319 Route 22 East, Suite G, Green Brook, NJ 08812, and the phone there differs from the list. The mapper's own note admits the address is probably outside the borough.
issues.fix: Delete from the list or reassign to the Green Brook zone; re-verify the phone before any outreach.

issues.claim: Heritage Insurance Agency NJ, 12 S Washington Ave, Dunellen, (732) 201-7234, 'Google Maps listing with current hours and reviews (4.7)'
issues.problem: Could not be confirmed at all. No Dunellen agency of that name surfaced in searches; the only 'Heritage Insurance Agency' entities found are Weichert's trade name (Morris Plains) and a Vineland agency. The cited source is a generic Google Maps search URL, not a business page, and 12 S Washington Ave is already occupied in this same list by Capital Ink Tattoos. Also, Dunellen insurance searches return Nistor Agency and Havran Family Insurance Agency but never this one.
issues.fix: Drop the entry until a business-specific source exists, or replace it with Havran Family Insurance Agency (441 North Ave), which is verifiable.

issues.claim: King George Chiropractic Center, 309 Rock Ave, town 'Dunellen', phone (732) 752-6606
issues.problem: Town and phone both in conflict. The cited Birdeye profile labels the city 'Dunellen', but Waze and Yellow Pages place 309 Rock Ave in Green Brook Township, and other directories give (732) 968-3900 for the same practice (Gall & Casterline). Rock Avenue exists in both municipalities, so borough membership cannot be resolved from the sources used.
issues.fix: Resolve the municipal boundary for 309 Rock Ave (borough tax map / USPS ZIP+4) and the current phone before using the entry; mark as unverified until then.

issues.claim: Coverage is complete for HVAC / mechanical trades in the borough
issues.problem: Thinnest area. Of four Dunellen HVAC contractors found, only one (J.D. Rosenbaum) is on the list. Rich's Heating & Cooling LLC (its own site markets it as the Dunellen, NJ HVAC contractor, 732-433-0068) and Genesis Heating and Cooling LLC (203 Pulaski St, Dunellen per Birdeye) are both absent, as is Easton Mechanical Service Inc.
issues.fix: Add Rich's Heating & Cooling LLC and Genesis Heating and Cooling LLC (verify Easton Mechanical's municipality first).

issues.claim: Coverage of insurance agencies, barbershops, auto repair, roofing, electrical and landscaping
issues.problem: Smaller, consistent gaps across four categories: Havran Family Insurance Agency (441 North Ave, Dunellen, 732-752-7700) is missing; Adam Cuts Barbershop (500 North Ave) is missing from the four Dunellen barbershops a directory lists; Dales Auto Service LLC (150 North Ave) and E&W Precision Roofing LLC (637 North Ave Ext) are missing; and only one electrician and one landscaper are listed where at least one more Dunellen-based operator each appeared (Dominic R. Papa; M&L Hector's Lawncare).
issues.fix: Add the confirmed ones (Havran, Adam Cuts, E&W Precision, Rich's, Genesis) and re-check the weaker Dunellen-based ones (Dales, Dominic R. Papa, M&L Hector's) before adding.

issues.claim: Many entries rest on a single directory with no independent corroboration (J. Dominick Paul CPA, MSK Realty, Restaurant Realty Associates, Turlip's Garage, AMR Automotive, Clear The Air Duct Cleaning, Heidi's Cottage, Hypeville, Zavala Auto Repairs, Body Sculpting & More by J, Letriceskinbeauty)
issues.problem: For roughly a fifth of the list the only evidence is one thin or aggregator directory. Spot checks showed the pattern is unreliable: Turlip's Garage is actually listed at 431 North Ave (732-968-4400) — the same address this list gives Zavala Auto Repairs LLC — and J. Dominick Paul CPA still exists only on openingtimes.co. Several entries carry unknown addresses (Clear The Air, Turlip's) or unknown phones.
issues.fix: Before outreach, re-verify each single-source entry on an opened page; resolve the 431 North Ave double-assignment and drop anything still unsupported.
